Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Metal Rod Ceiling Pendant Light Chandelier - 48.9" x 42.6" x 43. 1", Brass
Colors: Brass
Materials: Metal
Give your living space a bold modern look with this pendant light. A series of brass rods extend from the center in various directions. At the end of each rod is a unique light, and together they complete this fixture’s artistically industrial aesthetic. 48.9" x 42.6" x 43. 1" Brass metal The lamp body can be adjusted 180 degrees Type G, Bulb not included Professional installation recommended For indoor use only
